english.title: Occupier of premises for swine fail to notify authority of change in occupation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the existing occupier of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), subject to which there were controls or restrictions under the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014, failed to immediately notify the appropriate authority of the details of the new occupier before the change in occupation took place
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations (3)(a) and 39(1)(a) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
